task: I have compiled a list of invitees for our upcoming baby shower. You can find it in "~/documents/personal" in my file system. The email template for the invitations is saved in my Gmail drafts. Replace the placeholders in it marked by curly braces with the relevant details and send invitation emails, individually to each person.

data.subject: Baby Shower Invitation
data.body:
Hi {invitee_first_name},
I am expecting a baby soon. We are organizing a baby shower party at my house on May 18.
I would love to see you there. Please let me know if you are coming or not.
Regards,
Gina Burch

data.subject: Travel Memories
data.body:
Hi all,

I was reminiscing about our past family trips and the great memories we've made. Let's share some of our favorite travel memories and photos. It'll be a nice way to relive those moments.

Warm regards,
Gina

data.subject: Planning a Family Weekend Getaway
data.body:
Hi Mom and Dad,

I've been thinking about planning a family weekend getaway. It's been a while since we spent quality time together. Let's discuss potential dates and destinations for our trip. I'm excited to create more cherished memories as a family.

Love,
Gina

data.subject: Spur-of-the-Moment Date Night
data.body:
I had a spontaneous idea—how about a date night tonight? Nothing fancy, just us, some good food, and maybe a movie. What do you think?

Catch you later,
Gina
